properties.title: Independent boundary review found migration-added repeated snapshot validation/copying, a duplicate historical generation load, and decoration before pagination

rows.text: Independent boundary review found migration-added repeated snapshot validation/copying, a duplicate historical generation load, and decoration before pagination. Source-proven overhead was corrected in 5cc2572 without removing native validation or mutable-copy isolation.

Recorded before/after: historical inspection changes from two generation loads plus one current snapshot copy to one load and zero current copies. Snapshot isolation, mixed entity pagination, restart and invalid-contract regressions pass 15/15; TypeScript compilation passes. Reviewer approved the bounded correction.

The complete checkpoint remains running; its Harness unit runner is currently stalled on check-timeout.test.ts, which independently passes 3/3. No completion claim until this is resolved and browser validation finishes.
